note: Rule-generated model (finding F19): ground is the least relation closed under the nine full-strength introduction entries, TRANS.CUT and AMALG.INF, on structured propositions; no totality fact and no other grounding fact. The package is that of the Fine and Krämer targets without any irreflexivity entry. IRR.W fails: the universal truth ∀p(p ∨ ¬p) is among its own grounds and does not occur there vacuously (MR_not_vacuous), because every rule-generated ground of it contains it or its own instance (GR_universal). The two basic reflexive facts with an existential conclusion are vacuous (MR_existential_vacuous). CONJ.INF is not among the rules. One-world vacuity test (decision D2). INFERENCE: here the limit of D2 does not weaken the result, since grounds that are true without grounding could be true without grounding, so a failure of the one-world test is a failure of Woods's modal test
